findings.description: The loop now removes only param.opts and no longer removes param.secondary_opts, which the old code removed. A help name that is a secondary option of another parameter stays in the help option names.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a flag declared as @click.option('--color/--help') or similar, where a secondary option equals a help option name such as --help. The old code's difference_update(param.secondary_opts) reserved that name, so the help option was not created with it. The new loop skips secondary_opts, so --help is returned as a help name even though the flag already claims it. Impact: the help option and the flag both register the same name, so parsing --help may trigger the wrong parameter or fail with a conflict, which is a regression from the previous behavior.
